data.name: Slack: Find User by Email
data.description: Find a Slack user by their email address.
data.instructions:
Find a Slack user by their email address.

Look up a Slack workspace member using their email address.

**Inputs:**
- {email}: The email address to look up

**Output:** {result} contains the user's Slack profile including their user ID and display name.
